text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki heard about the recovery 
progress of Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro 
Ardan. However, there was still no 
timetable for their return...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two voice their anxiety, wondering if 
anyone is still waiting for them. Yaeno 
Muteki vows to keep running to protect a 
place for them to belong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Yaeno Muteki decided to run in the 
Arima Kinen. By making her presence known, 
she hoped to rekindle memories of the 
races she ran with the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once again, the clash between Oguri Cap 
and Tamamo Cross is drawing all the 
attention at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki resolved to capture that 
attention with her own running.
